summary: Examples show holding the python package to prevent upgrades and setting it back to install to allow upgrades.
questions: How do I prevent a package from being upgraded on Ubuntu?
How do I unhold a package with Ansible?

answer_card.title: dpkg_selections examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.dpkg_selections: {name: python, selection: hold}     # block upgrades
- ansible.builtin.dpkg_selections: {name: python, selection: install}  # allow upgrades
```
